compatibility_id_policy.current_meaning: stable repository and consumer identifier only

source_route_contract.required_identity_pattern: Rest of Season Proj Fantasy Football <Position> Stats

source_rank.usage: Visible provider row order on the successfully parsed CBS Sports rest-of-season position projection page.

Rank.usage: Deterministic position-only projection ranking and list-length-aware percentile input.
Rank.normalization: projected_fantasy_points descending with deterministic source-player-id tie breaking; Kicker additionally uses FGM and XPM before source_player_id

cross_source_comparison.projection_consensus_policy: average only comparable position percentiles; never average provider fantasy-point totals
cross_source_comparison.independence_note: CBS Sports is a direct projection provider. Do not double-count it through another consensus that already includes CBS Sports.

league_adjustments: Retain projected raw statistics independently of the CBS fantasy-point formula.
Do not treat CBS FPTS as Mighty Giants league points.
Treat the active CBS feed as rest-of-season expected production, not as the current weekly matchup projection.
Keep weekly lineup and kicker-streaming context in its separate weekly decision layer; never substitute a CBS Week N page into this season-projection contract.

For QB/RB/WR/TE, derive Mighty Giants core points only from scoring-relevant raw stats comparably projected by active providers; do not impute missing components such as two-point conversions or fumble-loss projections.
Apply six-team replacement level, two fixed QB, two fixed TE and four FLEX slots only during downstream interpretation.
Use current role, injury and competition evidence separately from the projection ranking.
limitations: The audited public page does not expose a reliable projection-specific Updated timestamp.
No documented public Projection API contract was confirmed on the audited CBS Sports surface.
The HTML parser depends on the public table and official CBS NFL player-link structure.
CBS route semantics can change with the provider's seasonal lifecycle; the active parser therefore requires an explicit Rest of Season source identity and rejects weekly identities.
Projection values are provider estimates and can change materially during the season.
Derived league-scoring core points intentionally omit non-comparable projected scoring components and are not a complete exact season-point forecast.
